sentences.text: Të dielën pas shërbimit Ana dhe Sami u nisën me autobusin për në fshat.
sentences.english: On Sunday after the service Ana and Sam set off by bus for the village.

sentences.text: Rruga ishte e gjatë dhe me shumë kthesa, dhe mali ngrihej para tyre me një mjegull të hollë.
sentences.english: The road was long and with many bends, and the mountain rose in front of them in a thin mist.

sentences.text: Kur zbritën, plaku i priste pranë rrugës, me kapelën e vjetër në dorë.
sentences.english: When they got off, the old man was waiting for them by the road, with his old hat in his hand.

sentences.text: — Erdhët! — thirri ai, dhe ky ishte rasti i parë që Ana e pa të buzëqeshte me të gjithë fytyrën.
sentences.english: "You came!" he called, and this was the first time Ana saw him smile with his whole face.

sentences.text: Shtëpia e tij ishte prej guri, me një pemë të madhe përpara dhe me një furrë të vogël në oborr.
sentences.english: His house was made of stone, with a big tree in front and a small oven in the yard.

sentences.text: Brenda ishte e pastër dhe e ftohtë, dhe mbi mur kishte një fotografi të vjetër me një grua me sy të mirë.
sentences.english: Inside it was clean and cold, and on the wall there was an old photograph of a woman with kind eyes.

sentences.text: — Kjo është Mari, — tha plaku.
sentences.english: "This is Mari," said the old man.

sentences.text: — Jetuam bashkë dyzet e tre vite.
sentences.english: "We lived together for forty-three years."

sentences.text: Ai ndezi zjarrin, vuri ujin dhe bëri një çaj me lule nga mali.
sentences.english: He lit the fire, put on the water and made a tea with herbs from the mountain.

sentences.text: Pastaj mori nga furra një bukë të nxehtë dhe e ndau në tri pjesë.
sentences.english: Then he took a hot loaf from the oven and divided it into three pieces.

sentences.text: Ata hëngrën pa folur shumë, dhe Sami e ndjeu se heshtja nuk ishte e rëndë.
sentences.english: They ate without speaking much, and Sam felt that the silence was not heavy.

sentences.text: — Po ti, bir, nuk je nga këtu, — i tha plaku Samit.
sentences.english: "And you, son, are not from here," the old man said to Sam.

sentences.text: — Çfarë të bëri të vish aq larg?
sentences.english: "What made you come so far?"

sentences.text: — Erdha për një vit, — u përgjigj Sami.
sentences.english: "I came for a year," Sam answered.

sentences.text: — Doja të mësoja gjuhën, dhe mendova se pas një viti do të ktheheshim në shtëpi.
sentences.english: "I wanted to learn the language, and I thought that after a year I would go back home."

sentences.text: — Por mbeta, sepse gjeta njerëz që më pritën si një djalë të tyre.
sentences.english: "But I stayed, because I found people who received me like a son of theirs."

sentences.text: — Atëherë je i yni, — tha plaku dhe i dha edhe pak bukë.
sentences.english: "Then you are ours," said the old man, and gave him another piece of bread.

sentences.text: — Këtu një i huaj është një mik që ende nuk e njohim.
sentences.english: "Here a stranger is a friend we do not yet know."

sentences.text: Pas pak plaku tha: — Dua të flas me ju për diçka që nuk e kam thënë kurrë para njerëzve.
sentences.english: After a while the old man said: "I want to talk with you about something that I have never said in front of people."

sentences.text: — Kur isha i vogël, kishat nuk ishin të hapura.
sentences.english: 'When I was small, the churches were not open.'

sentences.text: — Prindërit e mi nuk flisnin për Perëndinë në shtëpi.
sentences.english: 'My parents did not speak about God at home.'

sentences.text: — Në atë kohë njerëzit kishin frikë të thoshin edhe emrin e Perëndisë.
sentences.english: "In those days people were afraid even to say the name of God."

sentences.text: — Gjyshja ime më mësoi një lutje natën, kur gjithë shtëpia flinte, që të mos e dinte askush.
sentences.english: "My grandmother taught me a prayer at night, when the whole house was asleep, so that nobody would know."

sentences.text: — Më tha: «Mos e thuaj me zë të lartë, por mos e harro kurrë.»
sentences.english: "She said to me: 'Do not say it aloud, but never forget it.'"

sentences.text: Ana e pyeti nëse e kishte harruar.
sentences.english: Ana asked him whether he had forgotten it.

sentences.text: — Jo, — tha plaku.
sentences.english: "No," said the old man.

sentences.text: — E thosha çdo natë, edhe kur nuk besoja asgjë.
sentences.english: "I said it every night, even when I believed in nothing."

sentences.text: — Dhe kur u hapën kishat, shkova në një prej tyre dhe qava si fëmijë.
sentences.english: "And when the churches opened, I went to one of them and cried like a child."

sentences.text: — Më vjen turp ta them, — shtoi ai.
sentences.english: 'I am ashamed to say it,' he added.

sentences.text: — Nuk është turp të qash në kishë, baba, — tha Ana.
sentences.english: 'It is no shame to cry in church, father,' said Ana.

sentences.text: — Po pse nuk shkon më? — pyeti Sami me kujdes.
sentences.english: "But why do you no longer go?" asked Sam carefully.

sentences.text: — Sepse Mari vdiq, — u përgjigj plaku.
sentences.english: "Because Mari died," the old man answered.

sentences.text: — Ajo ishte ajo që më merrte për dore dhe më çonte.
sentences.english: "She was the one who took me by the hand and led me."

sentences.text: — Pa të, kisha frikë se do të flisja me një kishë bosh.
sentences.english: "Without her, I was afraid I would be speaking in an empty church."

sentences.text: Ana e preku krahun e tij.
sentences.english: Ana touched his arm.

sentences.text: Ana kishte lot në sy.
sentences.english: Ana had tears in her eyes.

sentences.text: — Nuk është bosh, baba, — tha ajo.
sentences.english: "It is not empty, father," she said.

sentences.text: — Nëse do, të dielën tjetër mund të vijmë të të marrim, dhe do të shkojmë bashkë.
sentences.english: "If you want, next Sunday we can come to get you, and we will go together."

sentences.text: Plaku nuk u përgjigj shpejt.
sentences.english: The old man did not answer quickly.

sentences.text: Pastaj tha me zë të ulët: — Nëse vini ju, do të vij edhe unë.
sentences.english: Then he said in a low voice: 'If you come, I will come too.'

sentences.text: Ana e pyeti përsëri nëse e donte vërtet, dhe ai e tha përsëri po.
sentences.english: Ana asked him again whether he really wanted it, and he said yes again.

sentences.text: Para se të niseshin, ai u dha një shishe me mjaltë.
sentences.english: Before they set off, he gave them a bottle of honey.

sentences.text: — Është nga bletët e saj, — tha.
sentences.english: "It is from her bees," he said.

sentences.text: — Ajo i kishte dashur më shumë se mua.
sentences.english: "She had loved them more than me."

sentences.text: Në autobus, kur po ktheheshin në qytet, Sami mori fletoren.
sentences.english: On the bus, as they were going back to the city, Sam took out his notebook.

sentences.text: Ai shkroi: «Sot mësova se ndonjëherë njeriu nuk ka nevojë për fjalë të mëdha, por për një njeri që e merr për dore.»
sentences.english: He wrote: "Today I learned that sometimes a person does not need big words, but someone who takes him by the hand."
